name: The A-Team
description: A fictional group of ex-United States Army Special Forces personnel work as soldiers of fortune while on the run from the Army after being branded as war criminals for a "crime they didn't commit."

videos.title: Rumours of Soldiers of Fortune, Interview with Stephen J. Cannell
videos.overview: Interview Stephen J. Cannell

videos.title: The Great 80's TV Flashback
videos.overview: "The Great 80's TV Flashback" takes a nostalgic look back at some of the decade's most beloved television shows. "The Great 80's TV Flashback" appears on the following DVD's: Charles In Charge Season 1, Magnum PI Season 4, Miami Vice Season 3, Gimmie a Break Season 1, The A-Team Season 4, Kate and Ally Season 1, Simon & Simon Season 1, Murder She Wrote Season 3, Quantum Leap Season 4, and Knight Rider Season 4.

videos.title: Mexican Slayride
videos.overview: Newspaper reporter, Amy Allen, sets out to prove the A-Team really exists and ends up hiring them to rescue one of her fellow reporters whose been kidnapped by Mexican outlaws.

videos.title: Children of Jamestown
videos.overview: After the A-Team rescues a girl from a crazed cult leader, they are captured by the man's followers and made the quarry of a death hunt.

videos.title: Pros and Cons
videos.overview: B.A.'s friend is held in a prison where the warden holds fight-to-the-death-boxing matches whose winner receives short-lived freedom.

videos.title: A Small and Deadly War
videos.overview: Hannibal plays cat and mouse with a renegade S.W.A.T. A-Team that's committing murders for hire.

videos.title: Black Day at Bad Rock
videos.overview: While treating a seriously wounded B.A., a suspicious small town doctor notifies the sheriff, who fears that B.A. may be part of a biker gang returning to free its jailed leader.

videos.title: The Rabbit Who Ate Las Vegas
videos.overview: The A-Team gets involved in a mob power play when two girls ask them to find their college professor who went to Las Vegas with a perfect gambling system and never came back.

videos.title: The Out-of-Towners
videos.overview: The A-Team takes up the cause of New York shopkeepers against neighborhood protection racketeers.

videos.title: Holiday in the Hills
videos.overview: B.A.'s fear of flying is justified when the A-Team's plane crashes in the backwoods where they must battle mountain men to keep a man from being burned at the stake.

videos.title: West Coast Turnaround
videos.overview: The A-Team delivers produce to the market for a farmer who is slowly being driven out of business by a land-hungry rancher.

videos.title: One More Time
videos.overview: The US government recruits the A-Team to rescue a general and his daughter from guerillas in Borneo.

videos.title: Till Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: The A-Team has to rescue a reluctant bride being forced to marry her late father's business partner.

videos.title: The Beast from the Belly of a Boeing
videos.overview: Hannibal's plan to free a hijacked airborne 747 requires a bit of adjustment when B.A. becomes cataleptic and Murdock temporarily blinded.

videos.title: A Nice Place to Visit
videos.overview: The A-Team comes to the aid of a small town being terrorized by a murderous family.

videos.title: Diamonds 'n Dust
videos.overview: The A-Team agrees to transport explosives to a Zimbabwe diamond mine after the owner dies trying to do it himself.

videos.title: Recipe for Heavy Bread
videos.overview: The cook from the A-Team's POW camp gives them a tip about a drug deal between the camp's former commander and a prisoner who had sold out to him.

videos.title: The Only Church in Town
videos.overview: Face convinces the A-Team to take his case when he receives his fraternity pin in a package from Ecuador from a woman who disappeared from his life fifteen years earlier.

videos.title: Bad Time on the Border
videos.overview: Hannibal goes undercover as an illegal alien when the A-Team is asked to find a sick woman who was apparently left behind by alien smugglers.

videos.title: When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
videos.overview: The A-Team must duck their Army pursuers as they try to stop wild horse rustlers.

videos.title: The Taxicab Wars
videos.overview: A small cab company hires the A-Team to thwart the sabotage efforts of a larger company trying to run them out of business.

videos.title: Labor Pains
videos.overview: The A-Team helps migrant workers to organize against a landowner that is forcing them to live and work under slave-labor conditions.

videos.title: There's Always a Catch
videos.overview: The A-Team must once again duck Decker as they try to stop an extortionist plaguing a small fishing village.

videos.title: Water, Water Everywhere
videos.overview: A land developer is trying to run three disabled Vietnam vets off the desert property they're renovating.

videos.title: Steel
videos.overview: The A-Team looks into sabotage at a construction site.

videos.title: The White Ballot
videos.overview: Face replaces a candidate who was killed while running for sheriff against a corrupt incumbent, and ends up getting the military after the whole A-Team when his photo is published in the newspaper.

videos.title: The Maltese Cow
videos.overview: Old friends who own a restaurant sponsored by the A-Team face an extortion threat from a Chinese tong.

videos.title: In Plane Sight
videos.overview: The A-Team employs a new method to prepare B.A. for a flight to South America, where drug smugglers are holding an innocent pilot prisoner.

videos.title: The Battle of Bel Air
videos.overview: The A-Team must rescue an employee of a security firm after she warns them about an ambush.

videos.title: Say It With Bullets
videos.overview: A WAC asks the A-Team to investigate the death of her brother, who was involved in arms trafficking at a military base.

videos.title: Pure-Dee Poison
videos.overview: The A-Team helps a southern minister stop the manufacture of lethal moonshine.

videos.title: It's a Desert Out There
videos.overview: The sophisticated commando tactics used by a gang for robbing busloads of tourists suggests to the A-Team that they're preparing for a bigger score.

videos.title: Chopping Spree
videos.overview: The A-Team uses their own vehicles, Face's Corvette and B.A.'s van, as bait for a car-stealing ring.

videos.title: Harder Than It Looks
videos.overview: The rescue of a kidnapping victim looks easy until the ransom is left behind and the victim insists on bringing along one of her captors.

videos.title: Deadly Maneuvers
videos.overview: Criminals foiled in the past by the A-Team hire a crew of mercenaries to pick off each member one by one.

videos.title: Semi-Friendly Persuasion
videos.overview: The A-Team faces an especially challenging mission when their pacifist clients forbid the use of violence against bigots trying to run their community off its land.

videos.title: Curtain Call
videos.overview: The A-Team reminisces (via flashbacks) about an injured Murdock as they look for a doctor and try to avoid a pursuing Decker.

videos.title: Bullets and Bikinis
videos.overview: Two girls ask the A-Team to take over their beachfront hotel after an alleged mobster keeps making bigger and bigger buyout offers that they refuse to take.

videos.title: The Bend in the River
videos.overview: Tawnia asks the A-Team to find her fiancé, an archaeologist last seen on an Amazon expedition that was attacked by a pirate.

videos.title: Fire
videos.overview: The A-Team faces another Army pursuit as they try to help a small town fire chief compete with a larger rival company.

videos.title: Timber!
videos.overview: The A-Team intercedes when a union organizer tries to put a small logging operation out of business.

videos.title: Double Heat
videos.overview: The A-Team is called in to find an accountant's daughter who has become a pawn in a game between two rival mobsters.

videos.title: Trouble on Wheels
videos.overview: Hannibal goes undercover in order to investigate employee theft from an auto plant.

videos.title: The Island
videos.overview: An Army doctor who once saved B.A.'s life calls in his debt by asking the A-Team to help deal with the thugs who have taken over the tropical island where he has set up a medical practice.

videos.title: Showdown!
videos.overview: Col. Lynch stakes out a Wild West show that has been terrorized by a group of A-Team impostors, sure that the real guys won't be able to ignore them.

videos.title: Sheriffs of Rivertown
videos.overview: The A-Team travels to South America where they become the law in a town built to house workers of a power plant that has been experiencing a number of fatal accidents.

videos.title: The Bells of St. Mary's
videos.overview: Threats from their old record label prompt a singing group who went to school with Face to ask the A-Team for help.

videos.title: Hot Styles
videos.overview: Face's latest girl friend is rather ungrateful after the A-Team rescues her from mobsters.

videos.title: Breakout!
videos.overview: After being taken hostage by bankrobbers B.A. and Murdock are named as accomplices and put in jail until Decker can come and get them.

videos.title: Cup A' Joe
videos.overview: A restaurateur tries to force the owners of a small diner to sell out to him after he arranges for a new freeway off-ramp to be built nearby.

videos.title: The Big Squeeze
videos.overview: The A-Team opens its own restaurant to lure a ruthless loan shark who has other restaurant owners terrified.

videos.title: Champ!
videos.overview: B.A. goes undercover as a boxer in order to put a drug-trafficking ring out of business.

videos.title: Skins
videos.overview: The A-Team travels to Kenya to deal with game poachers who have included a game warden among their kills.

videos.title: Road Games
videos.overview: Face infiltrates a gambling ring to clear a man's gambling debts and to save the foster home he runs.

videos.title: Moving Targets
videos.overview: A Middle Eastern potentate hires the A-Team to protect his about-to-be-married daughter despite her ideas to the contrary.

videos.title: Knights of the Road
videos.overview: The A-Team comes to the aid of an auto mechanic being driven out of business by a ruthless competitor.

videos.title: Waste 'Em!
videos.overview: The A-Team discovers a plot to dump toxic waste when they try to protect a man and his blind sister from harassment.

videos.title: Bounty
videos.overview: Murdock is kidnapped by bounty hunters that hope to use him as bait to capture the rest of the A-Team. When the Team arrives to rescue him, they find he has fallen in love with a veteranarian that's helped save him.

videos.title: Beverly Hills Assault
videos.overview: The A-Team goes uptown and gets involved with an art dealer who has been replacing original paintings with fakes.

videos.title: Trouble Brewing
videos.overview: Two sisters ask the A-Team for help when they are pressured to convert their all-natural soda pop bottling plant into a brewery.

videos.title: Incident at Crystal Lake
videos.overview: The A-Team's planned fishing vacation at a lakeside retreat is ruined when Decker and his men show up.

videos.title: Judgement Day
videos.overview: The A-Team goes to Italy to rescue a judge's daughter from mobsters, then must spend the journey home aboard an oceanliner dodging the boys trying to get her back.

videos.title: Where Is the Monster When You Need Him?
videos.overview: The A-Team must make do with movie prop guns against the real things when they are attacked while helping Hannibal and a friend film a low-budget movie in Mexico.

videos.title: Lease with an Option to Die
videos.overview: Some muscle men make a big mistake when they try to force B.A.'s momma out of her apartment.

videos.title: The Road to Hope
videos.overview: Hannibal poses as a wino to avoid being caught by the Army and stumbles onto a racket that involves killing the derelicts.

videos.title: The Heart of Rock n' Roll
videos.overview: Singer Rick James asks the A-Team to help an old rock-and-roll legend whose life in prison has suddenly become very dangerous.

videos.title: Body Slam
videos.overview: Hulk Hogan asks his old friend B.A. for the A-Team's help against a mobster who is out to close down a youth center for no apparent reason.

videos.title: Blood, Sweat and Cheers
videos.overview: Someone sabotages a car at a regional stock-car race and attracts the A-Team's attention-the car belongs to Hannibal's nephew.

videos.title: Mind Games
videos.overview: Face quits the A-Team after receiving a full government pardon and quickly becomes a celebrity, the rest of the A-Team keeps an eye on him suspecting the pardon's not 100% legit.

videos.title: There Goes the Neighborhood
videos.overview: The A-Team moves a rock star threatened with kidnapping into a quiet suburban neighborhood, which doesn't stay quite for long.

videos.title: The Doctor Is Out
videos.overview: The A-Team travels to South America to find Murdock's psychiatrist, accompanied by a woman claiming to be his daughter.

videos.title: Uncle Buckle-Up
videos.overview: The A-Team discovers a kiddie show is a front for a heroin ring when Hannibal auditions for a part.

videos.title: Wheel of Fortune
videos.overview: Murdock's fortunes rise and fall as he uses Face's system to win big on "Wheel of Fortune" but then is kidnapped during a plot to steal a Soviet gunship.

videos.title: The A-Team is Coming, The A-Team is Coming
videos.overview: Soviet spys need the A-Teams help in preventing the theft of an American satellite weapon, whose disappearance would disrupt world peace.

videos.title: Members Only
videos.overview: Face's chances of getting into an exclusive country club are severely hampered by the A-Team's battles on club property with a crooked bank president.

videos.title: Cowboy George
videos.overview: Face believes he's booked country singer Cowboy George into one of the roughest dance halls in the Southwest, but his agent friend delivers Boy George instead.

videos.title: Waiting for Insane Wayne
videos.overview: When Murdock gets mistaken for an insane mercenary the A-Team is drawn into a fight over property rights and an oil well.

videos.title: The Duke of Whispering Pines
videos.overview: One of B.A.'s old girlfriends has a problem; her husband, B.A.'s old college rival, has disappeared.

videos.title: Beneath the Surface
videos.overview: Face returns to his orphanage for a reunion and meets an old friend's sister, who's worried about her brother's disappearance, and an old girlfriend, who is in cahoots with Fulbright to trap Face for the reward.

videos.title: Mission of Peace
videos.overview: Senior citizens hire the A-Team to protect their historic Texas mission home and tourist attraction from land developers.

videos.title: The Trouble with Harry
videos.overview: Hulk Hogan comes to visit B.A. but the reunion is interrupted by a cry for help from a troubled youth with an alcoholic father.

videos.title: A Little Town with an Accent
videos.overview: The A-Team discovers an organized crime kingpin believed to be dead is behind the intimidation of several gas station owners.

videos.title: The Sound of Thunder
videos.overview: General Fulbright captures the A-Team then offers to let them prove their innocence by accompanying him to Vietnam and rescuing a POW who could clear their names.

videos.title: Dishpan Man
videos.overview: The A-Team is blackmailed by retired General Stockwell, who kidnaps Hannibal and threatens to have him prosecuted if the A-Team fails to secure the release of hostages held on a plane in Spain.

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: The A-Team's court martial begins and a surprising motive for the death of Colonel Morrison is revealed.

videos.title: Firing Line
videos.overview: General Stockwell interferes with the plans of Murdock and Frankie to free the rest of the A-Team before the Army can execute them.

videos.title: Quarterback Sneak
videos.overview: The A-Team uses a football game as a cover to sneak a chemical warfare scientist out of East Germany.

videos.title: The Theory of Revolution
videos.overview: The outbreak of a revolution interferes with the planned rescue of three Americans from a Third World Country.

videos.title: The Say UNCLE Affair
videos.overview: Stockwell is kidnapped by his former partner who has "gone bad" and the A-Team has 18 hours to find him or forever loose any chances of securing a pardon.

videos.title: Alive at Five
videos.overview: Face plans to leave the A-Team but gets involved in the rescue of a newswoman from a paranoid mob chief.

videos.title: Family Reunion
videos.overview: A former political adviser offers to trade a diary for a reunion with his daughter- who Face is hitting on, but Murdock learns that the man may be Face's father and the daughter Face's sister.

videos.title: Point of No Return
videos.overview: Stockwell refuses to allow the A-Team to go after Hannibal when he fails to check in while on a solo mission in hostile territory.

videos.title: The Crystal Skull
videos.overview: The A-Team's effort to secure a valuable religious artifact involves them with warring island tribes who mistake Murdoch for a God and some unusual missionaries.

videos.title: The Spy Who Mugged Me
videos.overview: Murdock poses as suave secret agent to catch a killer before he can complete another assignment.

videos.title: The Grey Team
videos.overview: The A-Team must bring a girl in who has stolen a briefcase from her father, filled with material she believes he's selling to the Soviets.

videos.title: Without Reservations
videos.overview: Frankie and Face visit Murdock at his job in a restaurant, and all three become hostages of mobsters out to kill a patron, the US Attorney General.

awards: Nominated for 3 Primetime Emmys. 4 wins & 5 nominations total
